messages.subject: StatET
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,

Is it possible to use Deducer and the Plot Builder from within the
StatET plugin console?

When I call deducer() and select Plots, Plot Builder from the RGui
Console, it works fine and contains datasets that I previously
loaded.  However, when I call deducer() and select Plot Builder from
within StatET, it opens the Plot Builder OK, but no datasets are
visible.

I saw a post on the StatET user group a few months back that there was
interest in extending the StatET plugin to integrate Deducer, so i'd
be interested to hear how that process is coming along.

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: RStudio and Deducer?
messages.body_plain:
Yes, I have spoken with J.J. about it. Right now, Deducer actually
does work through the text menu system ( deducer() ). RStudio does not
have any plug-in capabilities as of yet. When they are implemented,
Deducer will use them. The integration can't be as tight as with JGR,
but it can be a little tighter than the windows RGui.

messages.subject: Re: saving files and using regular r commands
messages.subject_clean: saving files and using regular r commands
messages.body_plain:
George,

That feature was turned off on the Mac. I've added it back it in the
development version of Deducer, so you will be able to save in
different formats with the next CRAN release.

You can load .robj files with the dget function, or just select the
file in the open data dialog and the gui will do this for you.

Ian
